A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EPG research and contain readable methods, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-G. Citation renumbering and layout changes can be matched reliably.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original pursuit-evasion experiments and ablations. Appendices C-F contain additional learning curves, case studies, robustness tests, and policy comparisons.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendices C-F retain the original empirical evaluations of EPG, including cross-graph performance, ablations, and robustness results.

M1.justification: The SAC-based training objective, equilibrium guidance, DP oracle, grouping mechanism, matching heuristic, distance features, and sequential policy architecture are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices B-C.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Dungeon maps, primary test graphs, Scale-Free and Singapore graphs, and enlarged real-world graphs. The no-exit and multi-exit task coverage in Section 4 and Appendices D-F is unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain DP, SPS, best-response policies, PSRO, Grasper, MT-PSRO, MT-PSRO-Aug, and Random where previously included. The three added bibliography entries introduce no evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Training budgets, hyperparameters, test samples, metrics, and initial-state restrictions are unchanged. Figure 4's correction from '5-exit' to '8-exit' aligns its caption with the eight-exit setting already stated in v1 Section 4.3 and Table 4.

E4.justification: Section 4.2 retains the same equilibrium-guidance, SAC-loss, and distance-feature ablations. Appendix D's case studies and Appendix E's success-condition robustness analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: The curve error bars and table uncertainty entries are unchanged, including Figure 3's identification of standard deviations. No seed information, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted curves, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Section 4.3 retains EPG values of 0.637 for Grid Map and 0.652 for Scotland-Yard Map.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorem 1, Proposition 1, and their Appendix A proofs are unchanged. The DP reasoning and matching-heuristic derivation also remain the same.

C1.justification: The zero-shot generalization, equilibrium-oracle, scalability, and comparative-performance claims retain their scope. The introduction now explicitly mentions the RL loss's importance, but this summarizes the existing Section 4.2 finding; the abstract and conclusion retain their scientific content.

C2.justification: The explanations of equilibrium guidance, distance features, and robustness are unchanged. Both versions retain the perfect-information limitation in Section 5 and the heuristic's exploitability qualification in Appendix B.

D1.justification: The introduction removes v1's '(simplified)' qualifier describing the linked code. The repository URL, supplementary-material pointer, and implementation details remain unchanged; this alters the code description without establishing any change to the available implementation.

R1.justification: The bibliography adds Chai et al.'s multi-task MARL survey, Sun et al.'s dual-value forward-backward representation work, and Zhao et al.'s sequential world-model work. All previous references remain; the additions receive no substantive discussion in the text.

P1.justification: The introduction's contribution bullets receive limited rewording, including explicit mention of ablation evidence for the RL loss. Author and affiliation text is revised, while the section structure and nearly all scientific prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: A compact author block keeps the entire abstract on page 1, a funding footnote is added there, and introduction spacing and bibliography pagination change. Figure 4's caption is corrected to '8-exit'; the figures and tables otherwise retain their displays.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves accuracy and readability by correcting Figure 4's inconsistent exit count and keeping the abstract together on the first page. The scientific evidence, methods, and proofs are unchanged. The added references provide no substantive new positioning, and removal of the code's 'simplified' qualifier does not establish improved reproducibility.
